positions.name: DeriveIdTestCoverage
positions.frame: what must the derive-id E2E test case reproduce and guarantee?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same test case from two angles: src-1 fixes what prior failure state the test must reproduce (the prod missing-id pattern on a ## heading), src-2 states the required outcome once that state is hit (no crash, valid slug). Read together they define a single test's design — the negative precondition and the positive postcondition of derive-id behavior. Power/register reads support this: src-1 speaks from expert citation of a known defect, src-2 speaks as a hard constraint on the fix — a diagnose-then-guarantee pairing, not two independent claims.
